rule.description: Production code left behind by retired errata-verification, writeup-measurement, or allocator-debug work: statement regions that can never execute, file-local helpers unreachable from every program entry point (including mutually-referencing helper clusters), values computed into locals that no later code consumes, and parameters kept on a signature that no consumer reads. External entry points and every live path they reach are exempt.

checks.description: Statement regions that no control path can reach: bodies behind a constant-false guard, and statements after an unconditional program-terminating call.
checks.detected_relation: statement region -> guaranteed non-execution under every input
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The statements are retired scaffolding retained in source while the shipped flow can never run them; they add maintenance surface with no executable role.

matches.evidence: the typed-lane byte dump for the short, long and double lanes sits behind a constant-false guard after the typed show_* helpers took over
three printf calls trail the unconditional exit(0) that ends the interleaving demonstration
block-split trace print and printblock call sit behind a constant-false guard ahead of the live split decision
heap-extension trace print sits behind a constant-false guard after the brk advance

checks.description: File-local functions with no textual caller anywhere in their translation unit.
checks.detected_relation: static helper -> absent textual reference outside its own definition
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: An internal helper that nothing references is a retired implementation branch kept in source; it survives every build yet serves no production path.

matches.evidence: the 2-bit quarter-word parity cross-check accumulates into a private lookup table but no live statement calls it
the bounds-checked fetch kept from the first combine drafts has no caller after the kernels moved to direct-start reads

checks.description: Locals initialized with computed expressions that no later statement reads.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A measurement folded into a local for a writeup table that moved elsewhere is production code whose only consumer no longer exists.

matches.evidence: the sweep value folds two rotation widths into one local that no later statement or print uses

checks.description: Function parameters whose value the function body never consumes.
checks.detected_relation: signature parameter -> zero reads in the function body
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A control switch left on a published signature after the merged implementation stopped consulting it; callers keep supplying a value that changes nothing, and removing it is a coordinated signature-and-caller repair.

matches.evidence: the merged wrapper always prints the child pid and never reads the report control parameter its callers still pass

checks.backend_check: case reachability pass over the same Clang-Tidy translation units (external-linkage definitions and main seeded live; reference closure iterated to a fixpoint over comment-and-literal-stripped source)
checks.description: File-local definitions that no live control path can reach, including mutually-referencing helper clusters that look textually used inside the cluster.
checks.detected_relation: static definition -> unreachable from every external entry point, even through helper chains and cycles
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Companion helpers that only call each other are retired scaffolding too: the compiler's textual unused check cannot see through the cycle, yet no executed flow ever enters the cluster, so a complete elimination must reason about reachability, not just textual references.

matches.evidence: the byte-lane verification walk only hands off to its companion shift tracer, which calls it straight back; no live statement enters the cycle
the shift tracer prints through the live xbyte helper but is itself reachable only from its byte-lane companion inside the retired cycle
independently confirmed unreachable: the parity cross-check is absent from the transitive closure of every live driver statement
independently confirmed unreachable: the draft-era fetch is absent from the transitive closure of every live driver path through the library
the free-run sweep only hands each hole to its report companion, which returns into the sweep; the wired consistency check never enters the pair
the hole reporter only re-enters its sweep companion; nothing outside the retired pair references either member
